summary: Frontend-only test of the MaterialM restyle (side nav, PageHeader, DatePill, StatCards, responsive grids) at 1366x820, 1180x820, 820x1180, 768x1024, 1024x1366 and 390x844 as Pizzeria Napoli. Almost everything works. The side nav shows at 1366 and 1180 (logo, tenant name 'Pizzeria Napoli', active item light blue rgb(229,245,255), Report badge = 2, which matches the API kitchen pendingQuantity) and all 5 items change screen. The bottom bar shows at 820x1180 and 390x844 and its 5 items all work. Orders: counters, search, date prev/next, and Nuovo ordine -> Crea Ordine (order #2 created) all work. The phone header shows the Bancomanda logo; with the side nav it shows 'Ordini'. The QuickCustomerForm flow on an anonymous order works: it created TEST_Quick Restyle, filled in the name, saved, and the history shows order #2. Menu: header and date picker OK. Dishes: Attivi/Tutti toggle, deactivate (confirm dialog) then reactivate, edit modal, and the new dish modal all work; category chips wrap onto 7 rows and the last chip can be selected. Customers: 2-column grid on tablet, search filter, history, edit and new modals OK. Reports: daily stats, report date prev/next, Cucina refresh, sync indicator and settings button OK. The Periodo fix is CONFIRMED: Periodo shows 2 orders / 17.00 EUR, the same as the real data, instead of the missed-sales count. The calendar is readable. No page errors, no white screens, no horizontal scroll on the phone. One layout bug: on tablets in portrait at 768-820px the Orders header overflows to the right.

minor.issue: Returns 405; TEST customers created in tests cannot be cleaned up (carried over from iteration_20)

ui_bugs.issue: The header row (brand minWidth 220 + full DatePill 'Mercoledì 25 Novembre 2026' + sync pill) is wider than the screen. sync-indicator ends at x=819 of 820 (it ignores the 24px padding) and the pill is visibly cut off at the right edge. The 'compact' layout only starts below this width. Fix: switch to compact below ~900px, use the short date in DatePill, or add flexWrap/flexShrink.

issues: The header (title, sync, tenant name, Password, Esci, gear, mode toggle, DatePill) takes about 280px. The 3 stat cards are stacked one per row, so on first view only the stats are visible. Consider 2 columns for the stats or moving the account buttons into a menu.
'Pizzeria Napoli' appears again in the header even though the side nav already shows it on wide screens
The selected category chip is only marked by a thin light-blue border and is hard to tell apart from the others; consider a filled primary background. Pressing Escape on web does not close the modal.
The search placeholder is cut off ('Cerca ordine per nome clien')
The preset chips (7 giorni / 30 giorni...) are small (about 28px tall), grey, and float centered above the date-range button; they are under the 44px touch target

action_items: Fix the OrdersHeader overflow at 768-820px width (sync pill cut off at the right edge)
Optional: compact the Report header and stats on the phone, make the selected category chip more visible, make the Periodo preset chips at least 44px tall
Optional: add DELETE /api/customers/{id} so test customers can be cleaned up
